content.comment_body: I am unable to connect using DNS services for [product_name] to transfer created web pages. If it's not currently possible, I hope future versions of [product_name] will support transfers via DNS. Sent from app.

It appears the [product_name] software currently does not support DNS or VPN connections. You can download [product_name] files over VPN, but not from [product_name]. I hope [company_name] addresses this soon, as it's an important missing feature.

I believe the lack of VPN upload may be due to security concerns. Nonetheless, having the ability for [product_name] to upload via VPN and DNS would be valuable in today’s work environment. It would be very beneficial if this became possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated by the absence of remote upload or download functionality in [product_name], particularly over DNS and VPN connections. This limitation restricts remote management, especially for those needing offsite access. The conversation underscores that this is a crucial capability missing in current versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect remote upload and download capabilities for web page designs through [product_name] with DNS and VPN support. They want secure and reliable online access to transfer files without needing physical proximity, anticipating that future updates will offer this functionality.
